content.title: MINERALS THAT BUILD YOUR {{THYROID}}
facts: **Iodine** is essential for making thyroid hormones that control your metabolism and energy levels
Seaweed like **nori and kelp** are among the richest natural sources of iodine
**Cod and shrimp** also provide meaningful amounts of iodine from the sea
**Iodized salt** was introduced decades ago specifically to prevent widespread deficiency
Dairy products like **yogurt** can contribute iodine depending on how animals were fed
